verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents an official MCP server, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page. Through it, agents can search Pinecone docs, manage indexes, upsert data and query indexes, with named client support for Claude, Cursor, Antigravity and Claude Code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Using the MCP server, agents can search Pinecone documentation, manage indexes, upsert data, and query indexes for relevant information.
Connect AI agents to Pinecone through the MCP server to search docs, manage indexes, and query data from Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, or Claude Code.
